name: new_sudoku_benchmark_900
description: A benchmark of 900 Sudoku puzzles designed to evaluate algorithmic and learning-based solvers on logical reasoning and combinatorial search. It measures a model or agent's ability to find correct full-grid solutions under varying puzzle difficulties and constraints. Metrics typically capture solved-instance rate and solution correctness; datasets often include a spread of easy to hard puzzles to probe generalization.
reputation: A niche benchmark used by researchers working on neural and hybrid Sudoku solvers and algorithmic reasoning; not widely adopted outside that community.
